info.name: Student Management System API - Newman Corrected
info.description:
Student Management System API collection. Student IDs are generated by the API; the collection captures the actual IDs returned by API-002 and API-003 and reuses them through unique collection variables. Do not assume fixed SID values. Run the collection in order so dependent requests use the IDs created in this run.

Automated Newman run. Expected HTTP status assertions are based on saved Postman examples, with API-005 updated to the fixed 400 response and API-022 set to 200 for the seeded workflow. Review assertions and execution results against the current API.

Recovered and corrected Newman collection. API-096 is sequenced before dependent updates; API-098/107/109/110 are sequenced with their dependencies; known stale assertions and search expectations have been corrected.
